issues.legal_issue: A municipal allotment may be made where the recipients accept the risk of eviction if the site is later used for its planned purpose, subject to the original allotment terms and the usual charges applicable to similarly situated recipients.
material_facts: The dispute concerned shops proposed to be allotted under an original allotment letter.
The municipal authority stated that the space was earmarked for parking under the master plan.
The appellants agreed to accept the shops at their own risk and to be liable to eviction if the master plan was implemented.
The Court specified that the allotment would follow the original allotment letter and that the appellants would pay the usual charges levied from similarly situated persons.
issues.conclusion: The appeal was disposed of on the basis of the appellants’ undertaking: the allotment was to be made in accordance with the original allotment letter, at the appellants’ risk of eviction upon implementation of the master plan, and subject to the usual charges paid by similarly situated persons.
issues.legal_principle: The Court relied on the appellants’ express acceptance of the risk of eviction and disposed of the appeal on that basis. It required the allotment to conform to the original allotment letter and made the recipients liable for the usual charges levied from similarly situated persons. No statutory provision or earlier case was relied on in deciding this issue.

rule.if: municipal_allotment_appeal and space_reserved_for_planned_use and claimants_accept_eviction_risk and original_allotment_terms_identifiable and usual_charges_apply_to_comparable_recipients

predicates.municipal_allotment_appeal: The proceeding is an appeal concerning a municipal land allotment.
predicates.space_reserved_for_planned_use: The municipal authority has identified the proposed allotment space for a use under a future plan.
predicates.claimants_accept_eviction_risk: The proposed recipients agree to accept the allotment at their own risk and to leave if the planned use is implemented.
predicates.original_allotment_terms_identifiable: An original allotment offer sets out the terms governing the allotment.
predicates.usual_charges_apply_to_comparable_recipi: Recipients in comparable circumstances are charged usual fees or charges.

issues.definition: When a municipal allotment appeal concerns space reserved for a planned use, the recipients accept the risk of eviction, the original allotment terms are identifiable, and comparable recipients pay usual charges, the allotment may proceed subject to those terms, that risk, and those charges.
